outline: AR/VR之人機互動應用已日漸普及, 其重要性已是不可言喻, 電腦圖學在日常生活中已經是一個不可或缺的科技 。因此本課程宗旨為教導學生電腦圖學之基礎理論,  並搭配OpenGL程式來開發3D互動程式。課程中將搭配業師協同教學, 指導學生如何開發符合使用者需求之應用程式, 課程將搭配實地探訪的方式, 理解使用者需求, 並設計出應用程式之雛形, 以及如何做到有效地使用者評估。
schedule:
Week01. Course Introduction , OpenGL setup
Week02. What is Computer Graphics
Week03. Basic OpenGL / Input and Interaction
Week04-5. Polygonal Meshes , Transformation, Hierarchical Modeling
Week06-7.Viewing & Projection
Week08. Midterm Project
Week09~10. Rasterization
Week 11~Week12. Lighting & Shading
Week12~13.  Texture mapping
Week14~15. Curve & Stroke
Week16. Special Topic
Week17. Special Topic
Week18. Final Project Demo
assessment:
Individual Projects 60%
OpenGL programming assignments 50%
Mini task 10%
Final Project 40%
